definitions.explanation: Relating to the study of kanji (Chinese characters) in Japanese context, especially for dictionaries organized by kanji.

examples.japanese: {漢和|かんわ}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To look up a kanji in a kanji dictionary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{読|よ}めない→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{漢和|かんわ}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I check kanji I can't read in a kanji dictionary.

examples.japanese: {漢和|かんわ}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部首|ぶしゅ}→部首：00023_bushu⟧⟦{索引|さくいん}→索引：04168_sakuin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Kanji dictionaries have a radical index.

notes:
USAGE: Primarily used in the term {漢和|かんわ}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧ (kanji dictionary).

KANJI DICTIONARY FEATURES:
- ⟦{部首|ぶしゅ}→部首：00023_bushu⟧⟦{索引|さくいん}→索引：04168_sakuin⟧ (radical index)
- ⟦{総画|そうかく}→総画：noentry⟧⟦{索引|さくいん}→索引：04168_sakuin⟧ (stroke count index)
- ⟦{音訓|おんくん}→音訓：25434_onkun⟧⟦{索引|さくいん}→索引：04168_sakuin⟧ (reading index)

HOW IT DIFFERS:
- {漢和|かんわ}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧ - looks up kanji by their components, gives readings and meanings
- ⟦{国語|こくご}→国語：02739_kokugo⟧⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧ - looks up words by their reading

NOTE: Essential for learning to read and write kanji, especially for native speakers learning new characters.
